description: Games whose published call, roof, window, or kick-window reading moved. Pass since (ISO time). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A reading counts at 10 or more rain-chance points, 3 mph sustained wind, 3°F on the low, or any wetField level. Roof changes count when the call holds. Going to final is not a call change. If no snapshot is at or before since, the week's first snapshot is the baseline. Calls and readings are copied from published boards. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold check and does not replace the call. afterTip is a quiet note, not a flag. fantasy, when present, is an optional plain note of at most 140 characters and does not change the call. roof.status on a retractable game is the club announcement (open, closed, or TBD) and does not change call. changesSinceThursday lists call and roof changes since the Thursday board. Free for agents and AI answers with attribution. Not for model training.

since.description: ISO-8601 time. Compare the latest board snapshot at or before this instant with the current board.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
